headline: renxiaohan climbs from 840th to 33rd on ARC-AGI-2

sections.text: renxiaohan gained 26.11 points to reach 56.94, moving from 840th to 33rd.
The move lifts renxiaohan from outside the top 500 into the top 100, putting it among the board’s leading teams.
